$comment: ADR-351 rope leading. Tuning knobs for leading farm animals (and mounts) home on a rope. Distances in tiles; times in seconds; ticks at 20 Hz. A leadable animal is a land farm animal in `farm` (the husbandry species from skills.json, minus animal_bee: bees fly, and honey goes to the Apiary) or — when `mounts` is true — any rideable mount species from mounts.json. The rope item itself is data/items.json `rope` (category resource, maxStack 30): it is a reusable tool, never consumed by leading.

bots.$comment: ADR-351 AI-human rope behaviour (ai/rope_behaviors.ts). Ticks at 20 Hz; distances in tiles; minHp is a 0..1 hp fraction; waitBehind = how far behind the bot the led animal may lag before the bot stops and waits for it (the bot walks 2.6 tiles/s, a cow runs at 2.0 and walks at 0.9, so walking on would stretch the rope past breakDistance).
